questions.content: Two concentric circles have centre O and radii 20 cm and 12 cm. A chord CD of the larger circle touches the smaller circle at T. Find CD.
questions.correct_answer: Given: inner radius OF = 12 cm, outer radius OD = 20 cm; chord DE touches the inner circle at F. Step 1: DE is tangent to the inner circle at F, so OF is perpendicular to DE (Theorem 10.1). Step 2: A perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects it, so F is the midpoint of DE. Step 3: In right triangle OFD, DF² = 20² - 12² = 256. Step 4: DF = 16 cm, hence DE = 2 DF = 32 cm. Step 5: Therefore DE = 32 cm.

questions.content: Using the configuration in Question 1, from external point N tangent NE = 15 cm touches the outer circle at E; secant NFK meets the circle at F (nearer N) and K with NF = 9 cm. Find NK and verify NE² = NF × NK.
questions.correct_answer: Given: outer radius OE = 20 cm, NE = 15 cm, NF = 9 cm. Step 1: Tangent-secant power gives NE² = NF × NK. Step 2: 225 = 9 × NK. Step 3: NK = 25 cm. Step 4: Check 9 × 25 = 225 = NE². Hence NK = 25 cm.

questions.content: A circle has centre O. Line m passes through V on the circle and meets the circle only at V. Radius OV is perpendicular to m at V. Prove that m is the tangent to the circle at V.
questions.correct_answer: Given: line through S meets the circle only at S; OS is perpendicular to the line at S. Step 1:829440OPSTacdeghilmnrstu ≠ S. Step 2: OS is perpendicular to the line, so OT < OS, placing T inside the circle - impossible. Step 3: Hence the line meets the circle only at S. Step 4: A line through a point on a circle and perpendicular to the radius at that point is tangent. Step 5: Therefore the line is tangent to the circle at S.

questions.content: Circles with centres P and Q have radii 2 cm and 10 cm respectively. If PQ = 17 cm, find the length of the direct common external tangent EF touching both circles.
questions.correct_answer: Given: radii 2 cm and 10 cm, centre distance PQ = 17 cm. Step 1: For a direct common external tangent, use offset (10 - 2) = 8 cm along PQ. Step 2: Right triangle with hypotenuse 17 cm and leg 8 cm. Step 3: Tangent length = √(17² - 8²) = 15 cm. Step 4: Parallel radii to contact points form a right trapezoid with the same tangent segment. Step 5: Hence the direct common external tangent has length 15 cm.

questions.content: In the configuration of Question 1, with NE = 15 cm from Question 2. (i) Find ON. (ii) Point L is 37 cm from O; tangent LM touches the outer circle at M. Secant LJK meets the circle at J (nearer L) with LJ = 17 cm. Find LK and verify LM² = LJ × LK.
questions.correct_answer: Given: OE = 20 cm, NE = 15 cm, OL = 37 cm, LJ = 17 cm. (i) Step 1: ON² = 20² + 15² = 625, ON = 25 cm. (ii) Step 2: LM² = 37² - 20² = 969. Step 3: 969 = 17 × LK, LK = 57 cm. Step 4: Check 17 × 57 = 969. Hence ON = 25 cm, LK = 57 cm.
